title: Uka Eco Ukax Acantilados Ukankiwa
intro: Mä valle amuytʼañäni, ukanjja qarqanakatwa utanakajj kʼutthapita, ukat thayajj mä ewjjtʼäwi jan istʼasaw amtasi. Mä kutix mä markaw akan jilxattawayi, bendicionata ukampis jan yäqasirjama, ukat mä chimpuw uñstawayi, uka qalat atinisipkäna uka pachpa.
clues: Qullunakat jan kuna jan waltʼäwin uñjasir utanakap lurir jaqinakäpxtwa, qalat lurat utanakajan jan kuna jan waltʼäwin uñjasisaw jikxatasirïta.
Chʼusa pampanakani ukat qalat lurat mä oraqenwa jakasipjjayäta, uka oraqejj jardinanaka ukat uma jalsunakan bendicitarakïnwa.
Jiwasanak taypit mä yatiyiriw jutäna, k’ari diosanakasar jaytañasataki, mä sapa cheq Luririru yupaychañataki.
Jachʼa jachʼa tukusaw mä condición iyawsañatak uttʼayapjjta: mä jan uñtʼat chimpuw uñstañapäna, uka señaljja, uka qalanakatwa mistuñapäna.

Kunawsatix arsutäki uka camello warmix qalat uñstkän ukhax mä qhana chimpunïnwa, jiwasan élite ukanakax waliw jan iyaw sapkänti ukat mä t’unjäwix jak’achasiniw sasin yatiyapkchïnsa, juparux ch’allt’apxäna.
Kimsa uru luratanakajat qhepatjja, mä qʼejjo qʼejjow valle taypin istʼasïna, ukat liwitat qʼañunakaruw tukuwayapjjta, utanakajajj sepulturanakajaruw tukuwayjjapjjta.

trial.answer: Allah sat warmin camellopan isquiotibiales sat chʼakhanakapa

arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَـٰلِحًا أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ فَإِذَا هُمْ فَرِيقَانِ يَخْتَصِمُونَ
verse: And We had certainly sent to Thamūd their brother Ṣāliḥ, [saying], "Worship Allāh," and at once they were two parties conflicting. (27:45)
